name: The Raid Boss
summary: Before you leave the catacombs, there is one final enemy standing in your way.

steps.journal: The way out runs through a great hall. Someone in armour is guarding it, wearing a seal I've seen on the Cathedral doors.

objectives.text: Defeat Trajan, Servant of the Emperor

steps.journal: Trajan fell. Before he died he said the Emperor would be pleased. Pleased with what?
